description: This source file defines the YearFrac class, which implements the Excel YEARFRAC function for calculating the fractional year between two dates using different methods. The class includes methods for computing the fraction, handling date calculations, and managing different date systems.

classes.name: YearFrac
classes.description: Implements the Excel YEARFRAC function to calculate the fractional year distance between two dates based on various methods.

methods.name: fraction
methods.description: Calculates the fraction of the year between startDate and endDate using specified method, handling array inputs for batch calculations.

methods.name: excelBug
methods.description: Handles special case where Excel's 1900 date system treats null date as 1900-01-00, adjusting the date value as needed.

methods.name: method1
methods.description: Calculates the fractional year using the Actual/actual method, considering leap years and date differences.
